name.zh: Montsechia 水生早期被子植物

description.en: Flexible branching shoots bear very small leaves and paired fruits, with no demonstrated root system.
description.zh: 柔韧分枝具细小叶及成对果实，未证实根系。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Montsechia vidalii; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Montsechia vidalii 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Small simple leaves and paired terminal fruits differ from Archaefructus's divided leaf fans.
distinctness.zh: 小型单叶及成对顶果区别于古果类的分裂叶扇。

modeling_brief.en: Use thin forked stems with small leaf tabs and paired ovoid fruits; leave unsupported roots absent.
modeling_brief.zh: 用细叉茎、小叶片和成对卵形果建形，不加入缺乏证据的根。

uncertainty: Submerged versus floating interpretations vary; no exact water depth is asserted.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Montsechia, an ancient aquatic angiosperm
sources.supports: Montsechia shoots, leaves, paired fruits and absent roots in studied specimens.
